content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone have an example of how to program touch buttons on the [product_name] HMI to adjust a setpoint in a [product_name] controller?

Are you planning to use a bit to switch the setpoint in the [product_name] using an analog multiplexer, or do you want to adjust the setpoint value directly on the HMI via an I/O field? Please clarify your question.

analysis.insight_summary: The user asks about integrating touch buttons on an HMI to adjust a setpoint in a controller, indicating a need for practical examples or clearer documentation. This reflects a gap in user resources for connecting HMI input fields to controller logic and points to an opportunity to improve guides or templates.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for simple, example-driven instructions to set up touch buttons on an HMI so they can directly change setpoints in the controller application.
